plan.select:
SELECT category_id,category_name,count(*)::int AS n,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)')))::int AS frame_n
      FROM public.consum_products p WHERE published IS TRUE
      AND (category_id::text||':'||coalesce(category_name,'')) COLLATE "C" > '' COLLATE "C"
      GROUP BY category_id,category_name ORDER BY (category_id::text||':'||coalesce(category_name,'')) COLLATE "C" LIMIT 500
